· 현재가($1582.95) vs SMA5/20/50($1761.45/$1789.40/$1740.94) - 단기·중기 이동평균선 하회, 약세 추세 위치 진단

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (5일 평균 대비 2.46배) - 최근 움직임에 힘 실림, 방향성 확인 시 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) - RSI 과매도 탈출 시도하나 MACD 악화로 추세 전환 불확실, 관망하며 방향성 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1582.95) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1761.45/$1789.40/$1740.94) - Below short-term/mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak trend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($1573.91)/SMA200 ($1375.05) - Approaching long-term moving averages, confirming trend weakening.
· 52-week position (68.3%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.4 → 41.1) - Entering oversold territory, staying neutral.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-15.7988 → -14.3892) - Weakness persists, no signs of improvement.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $1659.62) - Approaching lower band, with a band width of 14.51% suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1441.31) - Based on SMA200, a key support level on a decline.
· Swing Resistance ($1959.04) - Near 52-week high, a breakout could signal a trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) - Lack of clear direction, trend reversal confirmation needed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.46x vs 5-day average) - Recent price action is supported by volume, increasing confidence upon directional confirmation.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) - RSI attempting to exit oversold but MACD weakness makes trend reversal uncertain; awaiting directional confirmation.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일하며, 5일 고가가 20일 고가보다 낮아 뚜렷한 추세 없이 횡보하는 패턴이다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The daily chart shows a sideways pattern with the 5-day low and 20-day low being identical, and the 5-day high lower than the 20-day high, indicating no clear trend.
keyPoints: RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어나려 하지만 MACD는 약세 지속
ADX 11.9로 추세 미형성 구간, 충격성 변동 가능성 상존
주봉은 강세이나 일봉 기준으로는 방향성 불확실하여 관망 유지
keyPointsEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold, but MACD remains weak.
ADX at 11.9 indicates a non-trending phase with potential for shock-like volatility.
Despite a strong weekly trend, daily direction is uncertain, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.riskNoteEn: Risk of mistaking sharp moves for trend reversals in a non-trending phase (ADX 11.9).
